name: HD 349013B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list TOI-4463 A and HD 349013B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 4524517290642206336 and 4524517290642204928), 2,009 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 1.4e-5: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to TOI-4463 A, 2,009 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 8599017 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 8599017 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: HD 349013B is a star of 3,328 K, bound to TOI-4463 A 2,009 AU away.
text.introduction: HD 349013B shares its motion through space with TOI-4463 A, 2,009 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HD 349013B's orbit around TOI-4463 A is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4524517290642204928 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 60,000 of its distance per century
